reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters joined by «جميعا» stand at one level before Ibn Abi Umayr.
reasons.quote: جَمِيعاً عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ

reasons.claim: Bashir narrates from two Imams who speak together, so they are alternatives at the last level.
reasons.quote: عَنْ بَشِيرٍ النَّبَّالِ

reasons.claim: Khalid b. Sinan is named only inside the story and is no link.
reasons.quote: ابْنَةُ خَالِدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ

reasons.claim: The chain runs Ahmad b. Mani' to Jabir b. Samura, with «هو ابن أرطاة» only a gloss on al-Hajjaj.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا الحجاج، هو ابن أرطاة عن سماك بن حرب

reasons.claim: Jabir describes the Prophet himself, so he is the last link and the compiler's grading is no link.
reasons.quote: قال أبو عيسى هذا حديث حسن

reasons.claim: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib tells of an encounter in which Ibn Abbas speaks, so under ruling 9 Ibn Abbas is the last link.
reasons.quote: فقال له ابن عباس: إن علي

reasons.claim: The asking man is unnamed and only present in the scene, not a link.
reasons.quote: سمعت رجلا يسأل ابن عباس

reasons.claim: The nine transmitters before Ibn Abbas are read in the text's order.
reasons.quote: عن قتادة، عن سعيد بن المسيب

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters from Hammad meet at Abd Allah b. Shaqiq.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أيوب، وبديل، وعمران بن حدير، عن عبد الله بن شقيق

reasons.claim: The text ends with a bare «ح» and writes no further route, so only these routes can be read.
reasons.quote: عن ابن عمر، ح

reviews.uncertainty_note: The trailing «ح» suggests a second route written in another report, which this text cannot show.

reasons.claim: Abd al-Azim asks the Imam named in the words after the chain and the Imam answers, so the Imam is the last link (rulings 2 and 3).
reasons.quote: قُلْتُ لِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَى

reasons.claim: The later «قال عبد العظيم» continues the same story, not a new route.
reasons.quote: قَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَظِيمِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ

reasons.claim: Ja'far b. Muhammad narrates from his unnamed father, a relation link.
reasons.quote: قال حدثنا أبي قال

reasons.claim: Jabir, who was asked and told them, is the last link; the askers are the father's party.
reasons.quote: أتينا جابر بن عبد الله فسألناه

reasons.claim: The chain runs Qutayba to Jabir as written.
reasons.quote: عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، أن رجلا

reasons.claim: The man from Jayshan is a person in the story, and the dash phrase is a gloss.
reasons.quote: - وجيشان من اليمن -

reasons.claim: Three shaykhs say «قالوا» together and stand at one level.
reasons.quote: ومسدد، ومحمد بن عيسى، - المعنى - قالوا

reasons.claim: The dash remark only reports how one shaykh named Abd Allah b. Muhammad; it adds no route.
reasons.quote: قال ابن عيسى في حديثه ابن أبي بكر

reasons.claim: Aisha speaks, quoting the Prophet, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: فقالت سمعت رسول الله

reasons.claim: The chain runs al-Humaydi to Ibn Abbas, and «وكان ثقة» is a remark, not a name.
reasons.quote: حدثنا موسى بن أبي عائشة  وكان ثقة

reasons.claim: «ووصف سفيان» is a comment inside the saying, not a link.
reasons.quote: ووصف سفيان

reasons.claim: The chain runs Sa'id b. Abi Maryam to Sahl, with the bare kunya kept as written.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو غسان، حدثني أبو حازم، عن سهل

reasons.claim: The men in the story are not links.
reasons.quote: أن رجلا، من أعظم المسلمين
